sources.name: Profit by SKU & Date

columns.name: marketplace_id
columns.description: Amazon provided ID that represents a specific country where the Seller or Vendor operates.

columns.name: marketplace_country_code
columns.description: ISO country code for the Amazon marketplace.

columns.name: marketplace_country_name
columns.description: Human-readable country name for the marketplace (derived from marketplace_id).

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_id
columns.description: DataDoe account identifier used by MCP/API calls (sellers_and_vendors_list, exports). Not unique in amazon_sellers_and_vendors_context when one account has multiple connection contexts — join that table on connection_context_id instead.

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_name
columns.description: DataDoe connection context display name for the seller or vendor.

columns.name: marketplace_seller_id
columns.description: Amazon Seller Central seller ID from the connection (connection_seller_id). Null when the connection has no seller ID.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Date of the profit calculation in the local timezone of the marketplace. Each combination of marketplace, connection, child ASIN, SKU and date has a single row.

columns.name: parent_asin
columns.description: Current parent ASIN resolved from the seller listing variation parent SKU within the same Organization, store, seller, SP connection and marketplace, matching the child SKU and ASIN. Falls back to the marketplace catalog parent when the listing parent is missing, unresolved or ambiguous. Empty when neither source resolves a parent. This is the current hierarchy, not the relationship as of the sale date.

columns.name: item_supplier_name
columns.description: Comma-separated list of distinct supplier names from COGS uploads for shipped items.

columns.name: profit
columns.description: Net profit after subtracting sales_tax once. refund_cost is signed: cash outflows are negative and fee reversals are positive. Refunded tax is excluded.
columns.definition: amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.total_sales - amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.sales_tax - amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.total_fees - amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.cogs_total - amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.ad_spend + amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.refund_cost

columns.name: total_cost
columns.description: Sales tax included in prices, fees, COGS and ad spend, minus signed refund_cost.

columns.name: acos
columns.description: Advertising Cost of Sales as a percentage.

columns.name: tacos
columns.description: Total Advertising Cost of Sales as a percentage.

columns.name: roi
columns.description: Return on Investment as a percentage.

columns.name: total_sales
columns.description: Sales from shipped Amazon marketplace order items. Includes tax where Amazon reports prices with tax; see sales_tax. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines; their order-report amounts are fulfillment or declared values, not verified external-channel revenue.

columns.name: sales_tax
columns.description: Positive tax amount on shipped item and buyer-paid shipping prices for marketplaces whose selling prices include tax (all supported marketplaces except the US and Canada). Subtracted once from profit. Excludes gift-wrap tax; the P&L API uses item and gift-wrap tax while its shipping cost offsets buyer-paid shipping tax, so its sales_tax can differ.

columns.name: sales_tax_missing_items
columns.description: Number of shipped order items with a non-zero item price and no item tax, or a net shipping charge and no shipping tax, for marketplaces whose selling prices include tax (all supported marketplaces except the US and Canada). A positive count means sales_tax may be incomplete.

columns.name: total_sales_b2b
columns.description: Total sales from shipped B2B order items (order_is_business=true). Included in total_sales, not additive.

columns.name: total_sales_b2c
columns.description: Total sales from shipped B2C order items (order_is_business=false). Included in total_sales, not additive.

columns.name: unshipped_sales
columns.description: Sales from order items with one of unshipped statuses. Not included in total_sales.

columns.name: unshipped_units
columns.description: Units from Amazon marketplace order items whose status contains unshipped, ignoring case. Uses the purchase date and the same status filter as unshipped_sales. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines. Not included in total_units_sold.

columns.name: total_units_b2b
columns.description: Ordered units from order line items where order_is_business is true, excluding canceled items. Includes unshipped. Not the same as total_units_sold_b2b, which counts shipped units only.

columns.name: total_units_b2c
columns.description: Ordered units from order line items where order_is_business is false, excluding canceled items. Includes unshipped.

columns.name: total_units_sold
columns.description: Total quantity sold from shipped Amazon marketplace order items. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines.

columns.name: total_units_sold_b2b
columns.description: Shipped units from order line items where order_is_business is true. Included in total_units_sold, not additive.

columns.name: total_units_sold_b2c
columns.description: Shipped units from order line items where order_is_business is false. Included in total_units_sold, not additive.

columns.name: total_orders
columns.description: Distinct shipped Amazon marketplace orders this item appeared in. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines.

columns.name: refund_count
columns.description: Count of settlement_type REFUND financial events on posted date. Not SUM(quantity). A day can exist here with no sales if refunds posted that day.

columns.name: refund_cost
columns.description: Refund principal and fee reversals on the settlement posting date. Excludes refunded item, shipping and promotion tax. Return COGS is added on the return date. Not part of total_fees.

columns.name: return_units
columns.description: Returned units from amazon_returns on return receipt/request date, not payout date.

columns.name: return_cogs
columns.description: Item cost of returned units from amazon_returns on return receipt/request date. Not part of profit.

columns.name: cogs_item
columns.description: Total item COGS from shipped order items.

columns.name: cogs_shipping
columns.description: Total shipping COGS from shipped order items.

columns.name: lost_damaged_by_amazon
columns.description: Lost or damaged inventory reimbursements and charges on settlement posted date. Stored as a positive cost (settlement cash-flow sign flipped). Included in cogs_total, not in total_fees.

columns.name: missing_returns
columns.description: Missing-from-inbound inventory on settlement posted date. Stored as a positive cost (settlement cash-flow sign flipped). Included in cogs_total, not in total_fees.

columns.name: cogs_total
columns.description: Shipped-order COGS plus lost_damaged_by_amazon and missing_returns on posted date.

columns.name: cogs_present
columns.description: True when every shipped order item and return in this profit row has an applicable uploaded COGS record. False if any is missing; null when neither contributes. To list SKUs sold in the last 30 days without COGS, use GET /api/v1/cogs/missing or the MCP tool cogs_missing_list.

columns.name: total_fees
columns.description: Positive cost (settlement cash-flow sign flipped). Order fees use the order date when available; inbound, storage and similar fees use the posting date. Advertising is in ad_spend, inventory adjustments in cogs_total and refunds in refund_cost. Seller-retained sales tax on items, shipping and gift-wrap is excluded before the sign flip, accounting for withheld tax and marketplace-facilitator VAT. shipping_tax_discount is excluded too, because order shipping tax is already net of the shipping discount. promotion_tax_discount remains included in fees. Do not add this to amazon_settlements_with_cogs.total_non_principal_amount, which also includes non-fee payments.

columns.name: total_selling_fees
columns.description: Referral fee on non-REFUND settlements. Refunded referral fee and refund commission are in refund_cost, not here. Stored as a positive cost. Subtract from sales.

columns.name: total_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within total_fees, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the same dates and cost sign as total_fees; refunds are excluded. Zero means no tax amount was reported. Profit still uses the existing fee total.

columns.name: total_fees_net
columns.description: total_fees minus total_fees_tax. Excludes only tax reported by Amazon within this total; no tax rate is assumed. Profit still uses total_fees.

columns.name: total_selling_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within selling fees, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the same dates and cost sign as total_selling_fees; refunds are excluded. Zero means no tax amount was reported. Profit still uses the existing fee total.

columns.name: total_selling_fees_net
columns.description: total_selling_fees minus total_selling_fees_tax. Excludes only tax reported by Amazon within this total; no tax rate is assumed. Profit still uses total_selling_fees.

columns.name: fba_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within Fulfillment by Amazon fees, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the same dates and cost sign as fba_fees; refunds are excluded. Zero means no tax amount was reported. Profit still uses the existing fee total.

columns.name: fba_fees_net
columns.description: fba_fees minus fba_fees_tax. Excludes only tax reported by Amazon within this total; no tax rate is assumed. Profit still uses fba_fees.

columns.name: fba_fees
columns.description: Per-unit and other order-tied FBA fees use COALESCE(order_date, posted date); inbound, storage, LTSF and disposal use posted date. Stored as a positive cost. Subtract from sales.

columns.name: awd_fees
columns.description: AWD fees from Amazon settlements. Stored as a positive cost. Subtract from sales.

columns.name: ad_spend
columns.description: Ad spend attributed to this SKU. Sponsored Products and Sponsored Display use advertised-product reports. Sponsored Brands and Amazon DSP spend is estimated. Sponsored Brands spend uses eligible ad-creative ASINs, with same-day ad cost rescaled to campaign cost. Remaining spend uses campaign purchased-product shares. Without purchased-product data, it uses Seller Central sales, orders and sessions, or an even split among known campaign ASINs. Sales and orders allocate campaign totals by purchased-product shares, with the same fallback signals. ASIN spend and sales are split across available SKUs by same-day order-sales shares; orders use order-count shares. A zero total uses an even split for that measure. With no SKU rows, sku is null. Campaigns without any ASIN signal remain account-only. Amazon DSP line item spend is allocated by each ASIN's share of total product sales (including brand halo) on that day. Without positive sales, it uses purchases, then an even split among reported ASINs. Spend and promoted sales use same-day SKU order-sales shares; promoted orders and units use order-count shares. A zero total uses an even split for that measure. With no SKU rows, sku is null. Line items with no ASIN conversion rows remain account-only. Amazon DSP spend is DSP totalCost: supply cost plus Amazon fees, excluding third-party fees paid by the agency. Sponsored Television has no SKU allocation and appears only in amazon_profit_by_date.ad_spend. Unallocated DSP spend also appears only in amazon_profit_by_date.ad_spend.

columns.name: ad_sales
columns.description: Attributed ad sales of this SKU only (14d for SPONSORED_BRANDS and SPONSORED_DISPLAY, 7d for SPONSORED_PRODUCTS). Excludes brand halo; Sponsored Brands has no same-SKU sales. Includes Amazon DSP (14d attribution) for the promoted ASIN only, excluding brand halo.

columns.name: ad_orders
columns.description: Click-attributed orders of the advertised or promoted product for Sponsored Products and Sponsored Display (14d for SPONSORED_BRANDS and SPONSORED_DISPLAY, 7d for SPONSORED_PRODUCTS). Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Television contribute no SKU orders. Includes Amazon DSP (14d attribution) for the promoted ASIN only, excluding brand halo.

columns.name: ad_units_sold
columns.description: Sponsored Products same-SKU click-attributed units (7d) plus Sponsored Display total click-attributed units (14d, may include other products). Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Television contribute no SKU units. Includes Amazon DSP (14d attribution) for the promoted ASIN only, excluding brand halo.

columns.name: ad_clicks
columns.description: Attributed ad clicks. Excludes Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Television and Amazon DSP (not available per ASIN).

columns.name: ad_impressions
columns.description: Attributed ad impressions. Excludes Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Television and Amazon DSP (not available per ASIN).

columns.name: avg_buybox_percentage
columns.description: Buy box percentage for the child ASIN on this date. Buy box percentage is the share of page views where the buy box (add to cart) appeared for your offers. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: avg_buybox_percentage_b2b
columns.description: B2B buy box percentage for the child ASIN on this date, from Amazon Sales and Traffic buyBoxPercentageB2B. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: avg_buybox_percentage_b2c
columns.description: B2C buy box percentage for the child ASIN on this date. Amazon does not publish B2C buy box; reconstructed from overall and B2B buy box weighted by page views. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: total_sessions
columns.description: Sessions for the child ASIN on this date. A session is a visit to your Amazon product detail pages via browser or mobile app. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: sessions_b2b
columns.description: B2B sessions for the child ASIN on this date, from Amazon Sales and Traffic sessionsB2B. Included in total_sessions, not additive. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: sessions_b2c
columns.description: B2C sessions for the child ASIN on this date, calculated as total_sessions minus sessions_b2b. Amazon does not publish a B2C sessions field. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: ordered_product_sales

Missing report values remain empty. Repeats on each SKU row for the child ASIN. Read once per seller, marketplace, child ASIN and day, including rows with no SKU. sources.description: Daily profit and cost breakdown per SKU and child ASIN from shipped Amazon marketplace orders, settlement fees, COGS and ad spend. Off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines are excluded from sales, units, orders, tax, and COGS. Their order-report amounts are fulfillment or declared values, not verified external-channel revenue, and this table is not a complete MCF profit statement. Prefer this table for SKU and child-ASIN profit drill-down instead of calculating manually from other tables. Amazon Sales and Traffic provides child ASIN sessions, page views, buy box percentage, and unit session percentage. Those values repeat on every SKU row for that child ASIN and day. Read each traffic value once per child ASIN and day. Sponsored Products and Sponsored Display use reported advertised-product spend, sales and orders. Display units include all click-attributed purchases, not just the promoted product. Sponsored Brands contributes estimated spend but no same-SKU conversions. Amazon DSP (estimated spend) contributes promoted-ASIN sales, orders and units. Sponsored Brands spend uses eligible ad-creative ASINs, with same-day ad cost rescaled to campaign cost. Remaining spend uses campaign purchased-product shares. Without purchased-product data, it uses Seller Central sales, orders and sessions, or an even split among known campaign ASINs. Sales and orders allocate campaign totals by purchased-product shares, with the same fallback signals. ASIN spend and sales are split across available SKUs by same-day order-sales shares; orders use order-count shares. A zero total uses an even split for that measure. With no SKU rows, sku is null. Campaigns without any ASIN signal remain account-only. Amazon DSP line item spend is allocated by each ASIN's share of total product sales (including brand halo) on that day. Without positive sales, it uses purchases, then an even split among reported ASINs. Spend and promoted sales use same-day SKU order-sales shares; promoted orders and units use order-count shares. A zero total uses an even split for that measure. With no SKU rows, sku is null. Line items with no ASIN conversion rows remain account-only. Sponsored Television is account-only because its campaign report has no product allocation. Missing or delayed estimates can understate SKU ad spend and overstate SKU profit. Use amazon_profit_by_date for account-level P&L; SUM of SKU profit is not the account profit number.

dataAvailability.description: Intraday updates are available when source data changes during the day.

columns.name: marketplace_id
columns.description: Amazon provided ID that represents a specific country where the Seller or Vendor operates.

columns.name: marketplace_country_code
columns.description: ISO country code for the Amazon marketplace.

columns.name: marketplace_country_name
columns.description: Human-readable country name for the marketplace (derived from marketplace_id).

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_id
columns.description: DataDoe account identifier used by MCP/API calls (sellers_and_vendors_list, exports). Not unique in amazon_sellers_and_vendors_context when one account has multiple connection contexts — join that table on connection_context_id instead.

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_name
columns.description: DataDoe connection context display name for the seller or vendor.

columns.name: marketplace_seller_id
columns.description: Amazon Seller Central seller ID from the connection (connection_seller_id). Null when the connection has no seller ID.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Date of the profit calculation in the marketplace timezone. Each organization, store, marketplace, seller, currency and date has one row.

columns.name: item_supplier_name
columns.description: Comma-separated list of distinct supplier names from COGS uploads for shipped items.

columns.name: total_sales
columns.description: Sales from shipped Amazon marketplace order items. Includes tax where Amazon reports prices with tax; see sales_tax. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines; their order-report amounts are fulfillment or declared values, not verified external-channel revenue.

columns.name: sales_tax
columns.description: Positive tax amount on shipped item and buyer-paid shipping prices for marketplaces whose selling prices include tax (all supported marketplaces except the US and Canada). Subtracted once from profit. Excludes gift-wrap tax; the P&L API uses item and gift-wrap tax while its shipping cost offsets buyer-paid shipping tax, so its sales_tax can differ.

columns.name: sales_tax_missing_items
columns.description: Number of shipped order items with a non-zero item price and no item tax, or a net shipping charge and no shipping tax, for marketplaces whose selling prices include tax (all supported marketplaces except the US and Canada). A positive count means sales_tax may be incomplete.

columns.name: total_sales_b2b
columns.description: Total sales from shipped B2B order items (order_is_business=true). Included in total_sales, not additive.

columns.name: total_sales_b2c
columns.description: Total sales from shipped B2C order items (order_is_business=false). Included in total_sales, not additive.

columns.name: unshipped_sales
columns.description: Sales from order items with one of unshipped statuses. Not included in total_sales.

columns.name: unshipped_units
columns.description: Units from Amazon marketplace order items whose status contains unshipped, ignoring case. Uses the purchase date and the same status filter as unshipped_sales. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines. Not included in total_units_sold.

columns.name: total_units_b2b
columns.description: Ordered units from order line items where order_is_business is true, excluding canceled items. Includes unshipped. Not the same as total_units_sold_b2b, which counts shipped units only.

columns.name: total_units_b2c
columns.description: Ordered units from order line items where order_is_business is false, excluding canceled items. Includes unshipped.

columns.name: total_units_sold
columns.description: Total quantity sold from shipped Amazon marketplace order items. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines.

columns.name: total_units_sold_b2b
columns.description: Shipped units from order line items where order_is_business is true. Included in total_units_sold, not additive.

columns.name: total_units_sold_b2c
columns.description: Shipped units from order line items where order_is_business is false. Included in total_units_sold, not additive.

columns.name: total_orders
columns.description: Distinct shipped Amazon marketplace orders. Excludes off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines.

columns.name: refund_count
columns.description: Count of settlement_type REFUND financial events on posted date. Not SUM(quantity). A day can exist here with no sales if refunds posted that day.

columns.name: refund_cost
columns.description: Refund principal and fee reversals on the settlement posting date. Excludes refunded item, shipping and promotion tax. Return COGS is added on the return date. Not part of total_fees.

columns.name: return_units
columns.description: Returned units from amazon_returns on return receipt/request date, not payout date.

columns.name: return_cogs
columns.description: Item cost of returned units from amazon_returns on return receipt/request date. Not part of profit.

columns.name: cogs_item
columns.description: Total item COGS from shipped order items.

columns.name: cogs_shipping
columns.description: Total shipping COGS from shipped order items.

columns.name: lost_damaged_by_amazon
columns.description: Lost or damaged inventory reimbursements and charges on settlement posted date. Stored as a positive cost (settlement cash-flow sign flipped). Included in cogs_total, not in total_fees.

columns.name: missing_returns
columns.description: Missing-from-inbound inventory on settlement posted date. Stored as a positive cost (settlement cash-flow sign flipped). Included in cogs_total, not in total_fees.

columns.name: cogs_total
columns.description: Shipped-order COGS plus lost_damaged_by_amazon and missing_returns on posted date.

columns.name: cogs_present
columns.description: True when every shipped order item and return in this profit row has an applicable uploaded COGS record. False if any is missing; null when neither contributes. To list SKUs sold in the last 30 days without COGS, use GET /api/v1/cogs/missing or the MCP tool cogs_missing_list.

columns.name: total_fees
columns.description: Positive cost (settlement cash-flow sign flipped). Order fees use the order date when available; inbound, storage and similar fees use the posting date. Advertising is in ad_spend, inventory adjustments in cogs_total and refunds in refund_cost. Seller-retained sales tax on items, shipping and gift-wrap is excluded before the sign flip, accounting for withheld tax and marketplace-facilitator VAT. shipping_tax_discount is excluded too, because order shipping tax is already net of the shipping discount. promotion_tax_discount remains included in fees. Do not add this to amazon_settlements_with_cogs.total_non_principal_amount, which also includes non-fee payments.

columns.name: total_selling_fees
columns.description: Referral fee on non-REFUND settlements. Refunded referral fee and refund commission are in refund_cost, not here. Stored as a positive cost. Subtract from sales.

columns.name: total_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within total_fees, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the same dates and cost sign as total_fees; refunds are excluded. Zero means no tax amount was reported. Profit still uses the existing fee total.

columns.name: total_fees_net
columns.description: total_fees minus total_fees_tax. Excludes only tax reported by Amazon within this total; no tax rate is assumed. Profit still uses total_fees.

columns.name: total_selling_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within selling fees, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the same dates and cost sign as total_selling_fees; refunds are excluded. Zero means no tax amount was reported. Profit still uses the existing fee total.

columns.name: total_selling_fees_net
columns.description: total_selling_fees minus total_selling_fees_tax. Excludes only tax reported by Amazon within this total; no tax rate is assumed. Profit still uses total_selling_fees.

columns.name: fba_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within Fulfillment by Amazon fees, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the same dates and cost sign as fba_fees; refunds are excluded. Zero means no tax amount was reported. Profit still uses the existing fee total.

columns.name: fba_fees_net
columns.description: fba_fees minus fba_fees_tax. Excludes only tax reported by Amazon within this total; no tax rate is assumed. Profit still uses fba_fees.

columns.name: fba_fees
columns.description: Per-unit and other order-tied FBA fees use COALESCE(order_date, posted date); inbound, storage, LTSF and disposal use posted date. Stored as a positive cost. Subtract from sales.

columns.name: awd_fees
columns.description: AWD fees from Amazon settlements. Stored as a positive cost. Subtract from sales.

columns.name: ad_spend
columns.description: Ad spend of all campaign types: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, Sponsored Television and Amazon DSP. Amazon DSP spend is DSP totalCost: supply cost plus Amazon fees, excluding third-party fees paid by the agency. Includes all Sponsored Television spend and all DSP spend, including spend with no ASIN allocation. Use this for account advertising cost; it can exceed SUM(amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.ad_spend).

columns.name: sponsored_tv_ad_spend
columns.description: Sponsored Television campaign spend, included once in ad_spend and deducted once in profit. Account-only: the campaign report does not support SKU attribution. Do not add this amount to ad_spend or deduct it from profit again.

columns.name: ad_sales
columns.description: Attributed ad sales (14d for SPONSORED_BRANDS and SPONSORED_DISPLAY, 7d for SPONSORED_PRODUCTS). Includes Amazon DSP (14d attribution) with promoted ASINs plus brand halo, like Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display sales.

columns.name: ad_orders
columns.description: Attributed ad orders (14d for SPONSORED_BRANDS and SPONSORED_DISPLAY, 7d for SPONSORED_PRODUCTS). Includes Amazon DSP (14d attribution) with promoted ASINs plus brand halo, like Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display sales.

columns.name: ad_units_sold
columns.description: Attributed ad units sold (14d for SPONSORED_BRANDS and SPONSORED_DISPLAY, 7d for SPONSORED_PRODUCTS). Includes Amazon DSP (14d attribution) with promoted ASINs plus brand halo, like Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display sales.

columns.name: ad_clicks
columns.description: Attributed ad clicks, including Amazon DSP click-throughs.

columns.name: ad_impressions
columns.description: Attributed ad impressions, including Amazon DSP impressions.

columns.name: ad_target_reported_spend
columns.description: Target-report spend on this click date. Can differ from account ad_spend because report scopes differ. Null when no matching summary exists.
columns.definition: sum(amazon_ads_profit_by_target_and_date.ad_spend) by marketplace, seller, currency and date

columns.name: ad_target_reported_sales
columns.description: Sales attributed to targets on this click date. Sponsored Products uses seven days and Sponsored Brands uses 14 days. Null when no matching summary exists.
columns.definition: sum(amazon_ads_profit_by_target_and_date.ad_sales) by marketplace, seller, currency and date

columns.name: ad_target_count
columns.description: Number of target report rows on this date, including rows with spend and no sales. Null when no matching summary exists.
columns.definition: count(amazon_ads_profit_by_target_and_date rows) by marketplace, seller, currency and date

columns.name: ad_target_costed_sales
columns.description: Target sales from exactly the rows with a non-null profit estimate. Includes provisional rows and excludes partly costed rows. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_target_costed_spend
columns.description: Target spend from exactly the rows with a non-null profit estimate, including provisional and spend-only rows. Compare costed profit with this spend. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_target_unsupported_sales
columns.description: Target sales from ad types without product attribution for profit estimation. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_target_missing_cost_sales
columns.description: Target Sponsored Products sales on rows without a profit estimate because the Seller Central connection, costs or reconciliation are incomplete. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_target_costed_estimated_profit_after_ads
columns.description: Sum of available target profit estimates, including provisional and spend-only rows, excluding refunds. Use ad_target_costed_sales and ad_target_costed_spend for the matching scope. Null when no estimate is available. Overlaps the other ad summary and must not be added to account P&L.

columns.name: ad_target_mature_spend_without_sales
columns.description: Target spend with no attributed sales after the report attribution window has passed. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_search_term_reported_spend
columns.description: Search-term report spend on this click date. This overlaps target spend. Null when no matching summary exists.
columns.definition: sum(amazon_ads_profit_by_search_term_and_date.ad_spend) by marketplace, seller, currency and date

columns.name: ad_search_term_reported_sales
columns.description: Sales attributed to search terms on this click date. This overlaps target sales. Null when no matching summary exists.
columns.definition: sum(amazon_ads_profit_by_search_term_and_date.ad_sales) by marketplace, seller, currency and date

columns.name: ad_search_term_count
columns.description: Number of search-term report rows on this date. Null when no matching summary exists.
columns.definition: count(amazon_ads_profit_by_search_term_and_date rows) by marketplace, seller, currency and date

columns.name: ad_search_term_costed_sales
columns.description: Search-term sales from exactly the rows with a non-null profit estimate. Includes provisional rows and excludes partly costed rows. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_search_term_costed_spend
columns.description: Search-term spend from exactly the rows with a non-null profit estimate, including provisional and spend-only rows. Compare costed profit with this spend. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_search_term_unsupported_sales
columns.description: Search-term sales from ad types without product attribution for profit estimation. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_search_term_missing_cost_sales
columns.description: Search-term Sponsored Products sales on rows without a profit estimate because the Seller Central connection, parent target, costs or reconciliation are incomplete. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: ad_search_term_costed_estimated_profit_after_ads
columns.description: Sum of available search-term profit estimates, including provisional and spend-only rows, excluding refunds. Use ad_search_term_costed_sales and ad_search_term_costed_spend for the matching scope. Null when no estimate is available. Overlaps the other ad summary and must not be added to account P&L.

columns.name: ad_search_term_mature_spend_without_sales
columns.description: Search-term spend with no attributed sales after the report attribution window has passed. Null when no matching summary exists.

columns.name: avg_buybox_percentage
columns.description: Account-level buy box percentage for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic daily buyBoxPercentage. Buy box percentage is the share of page views where the buy box (add to cart) appeared for your offers. Falls back to the unweighted average of child ASINs when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: avg_buybox_percentage_b2b
columns.description: Account-level B2B buy box percentage for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic daily buyBoxPercentageB2B. Falls back to the unweighted average of child ASINs when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: avg_buybox_percentage_b2c
columns.description: Account-level B2C buy box percentage for the day. Amazon does not publish B2C buy box; reconstructed from the daily overall and B2B buy box weighted by page views. Falls back to the unweighted average of child ASINs when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: total_sessions
columns.description: Account-level sessions for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic daily sessions. A session is a visit to your Amazon product detail pages via browser or mobile app, counted once even when it covers several child ASINs, so it can be lower than asin_ sums. Falls back to the sum of child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: sessions_b2b
columns.description: Account-level B2B sessions for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic daily sessionsB2B. Included in total_sessions, not additive. Falls back to the sum of child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: sessions_b2c
columns.description: Account-level B2C sessions for the day, calculated as total_sessions minus sessions_b2b. Amazon does not publish a B2C sessions field. Falls back to the sum of child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: total_page_views
columns.description: Account-level page views for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic daily pageViews. Page views count visits to your Amazon product detail pages via browser or mobile app. Falls back to the sum of child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: page_views_b2b
columns.description: Account-level B2B page views for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic daily pageViewsB2B. Included in total_page_views, not additive. Falls back to the sum of child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: page_views_b2c
columns.description: Account-level B2C page views for the day, calculated as total_page_views minus page_views_b2b. Amazon does not publish a B2C page views field. Falls back to the sum of child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: ordered_product_sales
columns.description: Ordered product sales in the row currency for the account on this date, as reported by Amazon Sales and Traffic Data Kiosk orderedProductSales. Missing report values remain empty. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: ordered_product_sales_b2b

Included in ordered_product_sales, not additive. Missing report values remain empty. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: units_ordered

From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: units_ordered_b2b

Missing report values remain empty. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: total_order_items
columns.description: Order items ordered, not distinct orders for the account on this date, as reported by Amazon Sales and Traffic Data Kiosk totalOrderItems. Missing report values remain empty. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: total_order_items_b2b
columns.description: B2B order items ordered, not distinct orders for the account on this date, as reported by Amazon Sales and Traffic Data Kiosk totalOrderItemsB2B. Included in total_order_items, not additive. Missing report values remain empty. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: average_sales_per_order_item
columns.description: Account-level average ordered product sales per order item for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic averageSalesPerOrderItem. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: average_sales_per_order_item_b2b
columns.description: Account-level average ordered product sales per B2B order item for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic averageSalesPerOrderItemB2B. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: average_sales_per_order_item_b2c
columns.description: Account-level average ordered product sales per B2C order item for the day, reconstructed from overall and B2B averages weighted by order items. Amazon does not publish a B2C field. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: average_units_per_order_item
columns.description: Account-level average units per order item for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic averageUnitsPerOrderItem. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: average_units_per_order_item_b2b
columns.description: Account-level average units per B2B order item for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic averageUnitsPerOrderItemB2B. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: average_units_per_order_item_b2c
columns.description: Account-level average units per B2C order item for the day, reconstructed from overall and B2B averages weighted by order items. Amazon does not publish a B2C field. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: claims_granted
columns.description: Number of A-to-z Guarantee claims granted for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic claimsGranted. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

columns.name: claims_granted_b2b
columns.description: Number of A-to-z Guarantee claims granted for B2B orders for the day, from Amazon Sales and Traffic claimsGrantedB2B. Included in claims_granted, not additive. From Amazon Sales and Traffic (Data Kiosk). Data may be delayed by up to 3 days and may remain incomplete or be revised for up to 30 days after the row date due to Amazon reporting limitations.

sources.description: Daily profit and cost breakdown from shipped Amazon marketplace orders, settlement fees, COGS and ads spend. Off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment lines are excluded from sales, units, orders, tax, and COGS. Their order-report amounts are fulfillment or declared values, not verified external-channel revenue, and this table is not a complete MCF profit statement. Prefer this table for account-level P&L instead of calculating manually from other tables. Amazon Sales and Traffic provides account sessions, page views, buy box percentage, and unit session percentage. Target and search-term columns are separate Amazon Ads attribution summaries; their estimated profits are not included in account profit and must not be added together. Ads include Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, Sponsored Television and Amazon DSP. sponsored_tv_ad_spend isolates Television spend already included once in ad_spend and profit. Television has no SKU attribution. Amazon DSP spend is DSP totalCost and DSP ad sales, orders and units include promoted ASINs plus brand halo, consistent with Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display sales. Unallocated and account-level fees and ads spend land here, including all DSP spend, so ad_spend can exceed SUM(amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.ad_spend). Do not expect this profit to equal SUM(amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date.profit). Columns from average_sales_per_order_item through order_item_session_percentage_b2b are Amazon daily account totals from Sales and Traffic, filled for seller accounts only, and are not sums of per-ASIN rows. total_sessions, total_page_views, avg_buybox_percentage and their B2B and B2C variants also use the daily account totals, and fall back to child ASIN rows when the day has no account total. Columns starting with asin_ are per child ASIN Sales and Traffic values summed for the day.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Single date may occur multiple times.

columns.name: marketplace_id
columns.description: Amazon provided ID that represents a specific country where the Seller or Vendor operates.

columns.name: marketplace_country_code
columns.description: ISO country code for the Amazon marketplace.

columns.name: marketplace_country_name
columns.description: Human-readable country name for the marketplace (derived from marketplace_id).

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_id
columns.description: DataDoe account identifier used by MCP/API calls (sellers_and_vendors_list, exports). Not unique in amazon_sellers_and_vendors_context when one account has multiple connection contexts — join that table on connection_context_id instead.

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_name
columns.description: DataDoe connection context display name for the seller or vendor.

columns.name: marketplace_seller_id
columns.description: Amazon Seller Central seller ID from the connection (connection_seller_id). Null when the connection has no seller ID.

columns.name: buybox_percentage
columns.description: Share of page views where this offer won the Featured Offer (Buy Box). Amazon percentage on a 0–100 scale (report examples are values such as 98.54, not 0.9854).

columns.name: buybox_percentage_b2b
columns.description: B2B buy box percentage. Amazon percentage on a 0–100 scale (report examples are values such as 98.54, not 0.9854). Amazon Business subset of the matching total. Included in that total; do not add the two columns.

columns.name: units_session_percentage
columns.description: Units ordered divided by sessions. Amazon percentage on a 0–100 scale (report examples are values such as 98.54, not 0.9854). Can exceed 100 when a session buys more than one unit.

columns.name: page_views
columns.description: Page views from a browser or the mobile app. A page view is a visit, not a session. browser_page_views and mobile_page_views can count the same visit on both devices, so they can sum to more than page_views. B2B page views are the Amazon Business subset.

columns.name: page_views_b2b
columns.description: B2B page views. Amazon Business subset of the matching total. Included in that total; do not add the two columns.

columns.name: browser_page_views
columns.description: Page views from a browser. The same visit can also appear in mobile_page_views, so the two columns can sum to more than page_views.

columns.name: mobile_session
columns.description: Mobile-app sessions. A session is all visits by one user within 24 hours. browser_session and mobile_session can both count the same user, so they can sum to more than session.

columns.name: mobile_page_views
columns.description: Page views from the mobile app.

columns.name: session
columns.description: Sessions from browser or mobile app. A session is all visits by one user within 24 hours. browser_session and mobile_session can both count the same user, so they can sum to more than session.

columns.name: sessions_b2b
columns.description: B2B sessions. Amazon Business subset of the matching total. Included in that total; do not add the two columns. A session is all visits by one user within 24 hours. browser_session and mobile_session can both count the same user, so they can sum to more than session.

columns.name: browser_session
columns.description: Browser sessions. A session is all visits by one user within 24 hours. browser_session and mobile_session can both count the same user, so they can sum to more than session.

columns.name: total_sales
columns.description: Ordered product sales (price × units ordered), not shipped sales. B2B sales are included.

columns.name: total_units
columns.description: Units ordered. One order of 2 copies is 2 units. B2B units are included. Not shipped units.

columns.name: total_units_b2b
columns.description: B2B units ordered. Amazon Business subset of the matching total. Included in that total; do not add the two columns.

columns.name: total_orders
columns.description: Order items ordered, not orders and not units. B2B order items are included.

columns.name: shipped_product_sales
columns.description: Product sales Amazon has shipped. Not ordered sales (total_sales). B2B shipped sales are included.

columns.name: shipped_product_sales_b2b
columns.description: B2B shipped product sales. Amazon Business subset of the matching total. Included in that total; do not add the two columns.

sources.description: Order line items from Amazon order reports and recent ORDER_CHANGE updates, one row per order line. Marketplace orders belong to their marketplace connection. Off-Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) lines belong to the seller account and appear once per account, with regional attribution and null marketplace columns. Exports include them for any selected marketplace of that account; combining separate marketplace exports can count them more than once. sales_channel preserves Amazon's value, such as Non-Amazon. A generic value does not identify an external store, and a missing value does not identify MCF. Off-Amazon item_price_value is a fulfillment or declared amount, not verified external sales revenue. COGS uses the kept connection's uploaded costs. Profit tables and marketplace-filtered app reports omit off-Amazon lines. Initial reports cover 105 weeks of last-update time. Recurring reports re-read 8 days daily and 1 day intraday.

columns.name: attribution_method
columns.description: How the row was tied to a marketplace. connection: the row belongs to its marketplace connection. order / sales_channel: tied to the marketplace from the order or sales channel. regional: the row belongs to the whole seller account (regional_account_id), not to one marketplace; it appears once per account in exports for any selected marketplace of that account, and marketplace columns are null. columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Planned units for this shipment and seller SKU. This is not the number of units Amazon has received.

columns.name: quantity_shipped
columns.description: Units Amazon reports shipped for this shipment and seller SKU. Empty until Amazon supplies the field. Distinct from planned quantity.

columns.name: quantity_received
columns.description: Cumulative units Amazon reports as received for this shipment and seller SKU. This can be higher than quantity. Zero means Amazon reported zero. Empty means Amazon did not send the field.

columns.name: quantity_in_case
columns.description: Units in each case. This is not the number of cases or the shipment total. Zero means Amazon reported zero. Empty means Amazon did not send the field.

columns.name: release_date
columns.description: Date a preorder item becomes available for sale. This is not the shipment, receipt, delivery, or expiration date. Empty means Amazon did not send the field.

columns.name: carrier_name
columns.description: Name of the selected transportation carrier. Amazon may return Other when the seller uses their own carrier.

columns.name: shipping_mode
columns.description: Selected transportation mode, such as GROUND_SMALL_PARCEL, FREIGHT_LTL, or FREIGHT_FTL_PALLET.

sources.description: Estimated FBA fees for each active FBA offer, kept as a daily snapshot. snapshot_date is the UTC date Amazon finished the report. When a finish time is missing, it is the UTC date Amazon created the report. Amazon refreshes the estimates at least every 72 hours, so a later snapshot can repeat the same estimates. The report has no scheduled fee category and no effective date. A future fulfillment fee is a fulfillment estimate, not a scheduled referral fee category. Fees stay in the currency on the row. Dimensions and weight stay in the units on the row. A blank fee is unknown, not zero. A product missing from a snapshot had no active FBA offer in that snapshot. A snapshot for one marketplace is not copied to another marketplace. History starts when the first snapshot is collected.

columns.description: Product name from the returns report. FBA uses product-name. FBM uses item-name.

columns.description: Customer comments. Available only for FBA returns.

columns.description: Available only for FBM returns.

columns.description: FBA: return/receipt date at the fulfillment center (return-date). FBM: return request date.

columns.name: amazon_return_request_status
columns.description: Return request status. FBM values: 'Approved', 'Closed', 'PendingApproval'. FBA values: 'Unit returned to inventory', 'Reimbursed', 'Repackaged Successfully', 'IMMEDIATE_DISPOSAL', 'IMMEDIATE_DONATION', 'IMMEDIATE_LIQUIDATION'.

columns.name: amazon_return_rmaid
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns.

columns.name: amazon_return_seller_rmaid
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns.

columns.name: amazon_return_label_cost
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns.

columns.name: amazon_return_carrier
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns.

columns.name: amazon_return_delivery_date
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns. The date Amazon recorded that the return package was delivered, from Return delivery date on the FBM returns report. Null for FBA returns and when Amazon has not provided a date. This is a calendar date, not a time of day and not a carrier tracking status. The returns report refreshes daily.

columns.name: amazon_return_label_to_be_paid_by
columns.description: 'Seller' or 'Customer'.

columns.name: amazon_order_is_prime
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns (is-prime on the FBM returns report).

columns.name: amazon_return_refunded_amount
columns.description: Available only for FBM returns.

columns.name: amazon_return_reason
columns.description: Amazon return reason code. FBA uses the reason field from its customer returns report; common values include UNWANTED_ITEM and NOT_AS_DESCRIBED. FBM uses Return Reason from its returns report; common values include CR-UNWANTED_ITEM and AMZ-PG-BAD-DESC. These codes are not normalized: CR-UNWANTED_ITEM matches UNWANTED_ITEM, while AMZ-PG-BAD-DESC matches NOT_AS_DESCRIBED. Some codes do not follow these prefixes. Use amazon_fulfillment_channel and map equivalent codes before combining FBA and FBM reasons.

columns.name: amazon_return_detailed_disposition
columns.description: FBA only: condition assigned to a returned item by Amazon, separate from the customer's return reason. Observed values include SELLABLE, CUSTOMER_DAMAGED, DEFECTIVE, CARRIER_DAMAGED, and DAMAGED. Null for FBM returns. Only SELLABLE is treated as sellable in profit-table refund_cost.

columns.name: amazon_fulfillment_channel
columns.description: 'FBA' or 'FBM'

columns.name: amazon_fulfillment_channel_id
columns.description: Available only for FBA returns.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Returned units on this event.

columns.name: cogs_item_value
columns.description: Item COGS for returned units: unit item cost from amazon_cogs as of the return date, times quantity.

columns.name: cogs_shipping_value
columns.description: Shipping COGS for returned units: unit shipping cost from amazon_cogs as of the return date, times quantity.

columns.name: cogs_total_value
columns.description: Sum of cogs_item_value and cogs_shipping_value.

columns.name: cogs_present
columns.description: True when an uploaded COGS record applies to this row. Zero cost can still be valid. To list SKUs sold in the last 30 days without COGS, use GET /api/v1/cogs/missing or the MCP tool cogs_missing_list.

columns.name: cogs_currency
columns.description: Currency code for COGS.

columns.name: item_supplier_name
columns.description: Supplier name for the item COGS, if provided in COGS upload.

sources.description: Physical return events, not payout refunds. FBA rows are items received at a fulfillment center; date is return/receipt date. FBM rows are return requests by return-request date. quantity is returned units. fnsku and fba_customer_comments are FBA only. product_name is the name on the returns report (FBA product-name, FBM item-name). amazon_return_detailed_disposition is FBA only (SELLABLE, CUSTOMER_DAMAGED, DEFECTIVE, etc.). cogs_* is unit cost as of the return date, times quantity. For payout refunds use amazon_settlements_with_cogs where settlement_type is REFUND.

columns.name: marketplace_id
columns.description: Always empty. The notification belongs to the seller account. It does not name an Amazon marketplace or the external store.

columns.name: marketplace_country_code
columns.description: Always empty. See marketplace_id.

columns.name: marketplace_country_name
columns.description: Always empty. See marketplace_id.

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_id
columns.description: DataDoe seller context that received the notification.

columns.name: seller_or_vendor_name
columns.description: Display name of the seller context. Group by seller_or_vendor_id.

columns.name: marketplace_seller_id
columns.description: Amazon seller id from the connection that stored the notification.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) calendar day of event_time. Use it for from and to filters. It is not the purchase date and not a confirmed carrier ship date.

columns.name: fulfillment_order_id
columns.description: Seller fulfillment order id from the notification. The seller assigned this id. It is not an Amazon marketplace order id and it is not verified store revenue.

columns.name: amazon_shipment_id
columns.description: Amazon shipment id on the kept snapshot.

columns.name: shipment_item_id
columns.description: Amazon shipment item id. The same line can ship in more than one shipment item. Items without this id are omitted.

columns.name: line_item_id
columns.description: Seller line id when Amazon sends it.

columns.name: package_id
columns.description: Package id Amazon attached to the shipment item, when present.

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Amazon SKU on the shipment item, when Amazon sends it.

columns.name: facility_id
columns.description: Amazon facility id on the shipment, when Amazon sends it.

columns.name: shipped_quantity
columns.description: Units on this shipment item in the latest shipped snapshot, in EACHES. Repeated notifications are not added. A later snapshot replaces the quantity.

columns.name: event_time
columns.description: Amazon event time of the shipment-status notification kept for this shipment. This is not the purchase date and not a confirmed carrier ship date.

columns.name: coverage_started_at
columns.description: Earliest FULFILLMENT_ORDER_STATUS notification stored for this seller. Shipments before this time are absent.

columns.name: sp_api_notification_id
columns.description: Amazon notification id of the snapshot kept for this shipment.

columns.name: source_event_type
columns.description: Always SHIPMENT_STATUS_CHANGED. Package status events are not counted as additional shipments.

columns.name: shipment_status
columns.description: Always SHIPPED. A later snapshot that is not shipped removes the shipment from this table.

columns.name: product_cost_value
columns.description: Always empty. Uploaded product cost is not applied, because this order is not linked to a purchase date. Empty is not a zero cost.

columns.name: product_cost_currency
columns.description: Always empty. Currencies are not converted, and no cost amount is published.

columns.name: external_revenue_status
columns.description: Always unavailable. External store sales, shipping income, discounts, tax, and refunds are not imported. Unavailable is not zero.

columns.name: product_cost_status
columns.description: Always unavailable. See product_cost_value.

columns.name: amazon_fee_status
columns.description: Always omitted. Amazon fee debits and credits are not matched to this row. Omitted is not zero. Fees that already sit in account profit are not repeated here.

columns.name: uploaded_shipping_cost_status
columns.description: Always omitted. Uploaded shipping cost is not included. It is separate from Amazon outbound delivery fees.

columns.name: shared_storage_and_inbound_status
columns.description: Always excluded. Shared Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) storage and inbound costs stay in account profit and are not allocated to these units.

columns.name: returns_and_refunds_status
columns.description: Always deferred. A physical return or an Amazon fee credit does not change shipped units or create a refund amount.

columns.name: profit_status
columns.description: Always unavailable. Profit, margin, and ROI are not calculated.

sources.description: Confirmed Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) units Amazon reported as shipped. One row is one shipment item on the latest SHIPMENT_STATUS_CHANGED notification whose shipment status is SHIPPED. Rows appear only after this table, or MCF Fulfillment Order Status Notifications, is enabled. Shipments reported before the first stored notification are absent. A row does not show the full life of an order that started earlier. This is not profit, margin, or return on investment (ROI). External store sales, shipping income, discounts, tax, and refunds are unavailable, not zero. Uploaded product cost is unavailable because the seller fulfillment order id is not linked to a purchase date. Amazon fees are omitted and may already be inside Profit by Date and Profit by SKU and Date, so do not add those tables to this one. An omitted cost is not zero. Uploaded shipping cost, shared Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) storage, and inbound costs are excluded. A physical return does not change these units. A repeated notification does not add the same shipment item. A later notification replaces the earlier one. Package delivery events are not extra shipments. Declared order amounts are not sales.
sources.prerequisites: Seller Central only, for Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment in North America, Europe, and the Far East. Enable this table to collect FULFILLMENT_ORDER_STATUS notifications from that point forward. A seller without the Amazon Fulfillment role cannot subscribe. There is no historical backfill.

columns.name: child_asin
columns.description: Child ASIN from Seller Analytics. Rows are not grouped by parent ASIN, SKU, brand, or fulfillment channel.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Start of the period Amazon returned. For a week or month, this is the period start, not one day inside that period.

columns.name: period_start_date
columns.description: Start of the period Amazon returned. Same value as date.

columns.name: period_end_date
columns.description: End of the period Amazon returned.

columns.name: aggregation
columns.description: DAY, WEEK, or MONTH. Do not mix aggregations when you add review counts.

columns.name: display_rating
columns.description: Rounded product-page star rating, from 1 to 5. This is a snapshot, not reviews received in the period. Do not sum across periods.

columns.name: raw_rating
columns.description: Unrounded product star rating, from 1 to 5. This is a snapshot, not reviews received in the period. Do not sum across periods.

columns.name: total_rating_count
columns.description: Number of ratings included in the rating snapshot. Not the number of new reviews in the period. Do not sum across periods. Empty when Amazon returned no rating snapshot; Amazon sends a count of 0 without a star rating in that case, which is not a real zero.

columns.name: total_review_count
columns.description: Reviews received in the returned period. Add counts only for non-overlapping periods with the same aggregation.

columns.name: low_rating_review_count
columns.description: Critical reviews received in the returned period. This is a count, not the text of those reviews. Add counts only for non-overlapping periods with the same aggregation.

columns.name: critical_review_rate
columns.description: Fraction from 0 to 1 of period reviews that are critical. Do not average this rate across rows. For compatible periods, divide the summed low-rating review count by the summed review count.

columns.name: activity_last_seen_at
columns.description: Latest successful import of the review-count values for this row.

columns.name: rating_last_seen_at
columns.description: Latest successful import of the rating snapshot for this row. Set even when Amazon returned no rating, so it does not mean a rating is present.

sources.description: Product star ratings and review counts by child ASIN, marketplace, and period for a Seller Central account. This is not buyer feedback left for the seller, and it does not include review text. Review counts cover the returned period. Ratings are the product rating at the snapshot, not new reviews in that period. date is the start of the period Amazon returned. A week or month stays one row. An empty metric means Amazon did not return a value. It is not a confirmed zero. A stored review count of zero is a real zero. An empty total_rating_count with empty ratings means Amazon returned no rating snapshot for that ASIN and period, not that the product has no ratings. Initial collection covers 365 days of activity and 12 completed calendar months of rating snapshots. Activity refreshes cover seven days daily and 31 days every 30 days in batches of at most seven days with DAY output. Amazon returns the star rating for a completed calendar month. A single day does not include the star rating. Amazon returns rating snapshots for only some ASINs, and for some accounts a completed month has no products. Such a month adds no MONTH row. The latest completed month refreshes every day. Two completed months refresh every 30 days. Amazon does not return the calendar month that is still in progress.
sources.prerequisites: Requires a Seller Central connection. Vendor Central does not provide these product ratings and review counts.

dataAvailability.description: Review counts and rating snapshots are generally ready at 10am in the marketplace time zone, two days after the period. A later refresh can restate recent days.

sources.description: Seller Central finances transactions, one latest stored row per transaction id on a DataDoe connection. A hold and its release stay as separate rows when Amazon gives them separate ids. total_amount is the signed total Amazon sent, once per row, in the reported currency. Summing every row counts a hold and its release twice and mixes Transfers with sales. For a deferred forecast, use is_outstanding_deferred = TRUE, group by currency, and keep rows with an empty expected_release_at or total_amount. posted_at is the UTC posting time of this transaction id. date is that instant as a marketplace-local calendar date, with America/Los_Angeles for the US and Canada, and Export from and to filters use date. expected_release_at is the maturity time Amazon reported while the transaction is deferred. It can change and is not a bank deposit time. is_outstanding_deferred is true only for a stored DEFERRED status with no stored release. The first finances load reads 370 one-day posted windows, the daily load reads 8 one-day windows, and the 10am and 4pm loads read 2 posted days in the marketplace time zone. Those are start times, not a promise of when the row appears. Deferred rows outside those windows can keep an old status, reason, or maturity time. A later release row can clear a known hold. This table does not list every current hold at Amazon. Sums skip empty amounts.

dataAvailability.description: The daily fetch starts at 2am and rereads 8 days. Fetches also start at 10am and 4pm, including weekends, and reread 2 days, including the current day. US and Canada use Pacific time (America/Los_Angeles) for the 10am and 4pm fetches, including daylight saving. Other marketplaces use their local time zone. Amazon may leave out orders from the last 48 hours. These times are when the fetch starts. Rows appear after Amazon publishes them and after DataDoe finishes processing and export.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Marketplace-local date of the winning transaction posted time (America/Los_Angeles for US and CA). Once released this is the Transaction Release Date; while deferred it is the local date of the deferred posting. It can be one day earlier than the UTC posted timestamp near midnight, and it may differ from the order date. This column is used for the from/to filters on Export creation.

columns.name: transaction_posted_date
columns.description: Marketplace local date on which Amazon first posted the transaction (deferred posting time for deferred transactions). Matches the date/time column of the Amazon Transaction report. For deferred orders this is earlier than date. US and CA use America/Los_Angeles.

columns.name: transaction_release_date
columns.description: Marketplace local date on which Amazon released the transaction. Matches the Transaction Release Date column of the Amazon Transaction report and equals date once released. Empty while the transaction is still deferred. US and CA use America/Los_Angeles.

columns.name: settlement_type
columns.description: ORDER, REFUND or OTHER. REFUND is a payout refund money event, not a warehouse return.

columns.name: transaction_status
columns.description: Amazon transaction status: RELEASED, DEFERRED or DEFERRED_RELEASED. Missing or blank status is treated as RELEASED. A deferred hold and its later release count as one row.

columns.name: merchant_order_id
columns.description: Private seller order id.

columns.name: order_fulfillment_channel
columns.description: The fulfillment channel of the order (Amazon or Merchant).

columns.name: financial_event_group_id
columns.description: Amazon financial event group identifier when available.

columns.name: settlement_id
columns.description: Amazon settlement identifier when available.

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date of the order if the row is related to an order. This it prefered column for calculating profit over period of time. May be the same or up to 30 days later than the date of the settlement date.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Do not SUM(quantity) on REFUND rows as monthly refunded units. For warehouse returns use amazon_returns. For refunded units on the sales-performance timeline use amazon_sales_and_traffic_with_cogs.units_refunded.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Currency code.

columns.name: total_fees
columns.description: Deprecated, will be removed on 2026-10-31. total_non_principal_amount holds the same value.

columns.name: total_non_principal_amount
columns.description: total minus item_price, in the payout sign: negative means money to Amazon. Includes customer-paid shipping, tax, promotions, reimbursements, advertising, and lost or missing inventory, not only fees.

columns.name: total_selling_fees
columns.description: Referral fee plus refund commission plus refunded referral fee, in the payout sign. Negative on ORDER rows. REFUND rows add the refunded referral fee (positive, credited back) and the refund commission (negative). amazon_profit_by_date and amazon_profit_by_sku_and_date total_selling_fees use only non-REFUND rows, with the sign flipped.

columns.name: total
columns.description: Sum of all amounts in the row. May be a negative number.

columns.name: referral_fee_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within referral_fee, including value added tax (VAT). Uses the settlement cash-flow sign. Zero means no tax amount was reported.

columns.name: referral_fee_net
columns.description: referral_fee minus referral_fee_tax, in the settlement cash-flow sign. Excludes only reported tax; no tax rate is assumed.

columns.name: fba_per_unit_fulfillment_fee_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within the per-unit Fulfillment by Amazon fee. Uses the settlement cash-flow sign. Zero means no tax amount was reported.

columns.name: fba_per_unit_fulfillment_fee_net
columns.description: fba_per_unit_fulfillment_fee minus fba_per_unit_fulfillment_fee_tax, in the settlement cash-flow sign.

columns.name: total_selling_fees_tax
columns.description: Tax reported by Amazon within referral fees, refunded referral fees and refund commissions. Uses the settlement cash-flow sign.

columns.name: total_selling_fees_net
columns.description: total_selling_fees minus total_selling_fees_tax, in the settlement cash-flow sign. Includes fee reversals on REFUND rows.

columns.name: order_fees_tax
columns.description: Reported tax included in fees assigned to the order date by the profit tables. Uses the settlement cash-flow sign. Excludes sales tax and tax already excluded from the existing fee total.

columns.name: posted_fees_tax
columns.description: Reported tax included in fees assigned to the posting date by the profit tables. Uses the settlement cash-flow sign. Excludes tax already excluded from the existing fee total.

columns.name: order_fba_fees_tax
columns.description: Reported tax within order-tied Fulfillment by Amazon fees, in the settlement cash-flow sign.

columns.name: posted_fba_fees_tax
columns.description: Reported tax within posting-date Fulfillment by Amazon fees, in the settlement cash-flow sign. Excludes tax already excluded from the existing fee total.

columns.name: total_fees_tax
columns.description: order_fees_tax plus posted_fees_tax, in the settlement cash-flow sign. Includes only reported tax within the existing fee total.

columns.name: total_fees_net
columns.description: total_fees minus total_fees_tax, in the settlement cash-flow sign. Like total_fees, this also includes non-fee payments. No tax rate is assumed.

columns.name: coupon_redemption_fee
columns.description: Amazon fee charged per coupon redemption. This is a fee, not the discount given to customers (see promotion_item_price). Distinct from coupon_performance_fee.

columns.name: coupon_performance_fee
columns.description: Amazon coupon performance-based fee. This is a fee, not the discount given to customers (see promotion_item_price). Distinct from coupon_redemption_fee.

columns.name: coupon_participation_fee
columns.description: Amazon coupon participation fee. This is a fee, not the discount given to customers (see promotion_item_price).

columns.name: deal_performance_fee
columns.description: Deal performance-based fee.

columns.name: deal_participation_fee
columns.description: Deal participation fee, including Lightning Deal and Best Deal amounts. Finances does not distinguish Lightning from Best Deal.

columns.name: removal_order_lost
columns.description: FBA inventory reimbursement when a removal order is marked lost.

columns.name: points_granted
columns.description: Japan marketplace Amazon Points granted on the order. Other marketplaces are 0.

columns.name: item_tax
columns.description: Item tax on the sale. Also receives tax Amazon reports separately on inbound transportation fees. Settlement report tax on fee lines for inbound fees map here too.

columns.name: item_shipping_chargeback
columns.description: FBA ShippingChargeback from Finances ItemFees: Amazon charges back outbound shipping cost to the seller.

columns.name: item_digital_services_fee
columns.description: Digital Services Fee on the original sale (Digital Services Fee / DigitalServicesFee ItemFees). Percentage surcharge Amazon applies to Selling on Amazon and FBA fees to recover digital services taxes in some countries.

columns.name: fba_inbound_convenience_fee
columns.description: FBA inbound convenience fee. Finances breakdown paths that include InboundConvenienceCharge are placement fees and are not stored here.

columns.name: fee_adjustment
columns.description: Fulfillment fee adjustments from Finances ServiceFee FulfillmentAdjustment, and settlement transaction type Fee Adjustment. Expenses are negative.

columns.name: amazon_fees
columns.description: Sum of all other Amazon account fees.

columns.name: marketplace_facilitator_vat
columns.description: EU/UK MarketplaceFacilitatorVAT-* ItemWithheldTax withheld by Amazon as marketplace facilitator VAT on the sale. US MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-* stays in item_withheld_tax.

columns.name: digital_services_fee
columns.description: Digital Services Fee when the Finances/settlement triple is not a typed Order or Refund ItemFees line (catch-all for DigitalServicesFee). Prefer item_digital_services_fee / refund_digital_services_fee when those are populated.

columns.name: item_withheld_tax
columns.description: ItemWithheldTax on the sale, including US MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-*. EU/UK MarketplaceFacilitatorVAT-* is in marketplace_facilitator_vat.

columns.name: promotion_item_price
columns.description: Item and coupon discount on orders (Promotion/Principal). Negative. This is money given to the customer, not an Amazon fee. Refunds of it are in promotion.

columns.name: promotion_fee
columns.description: Deprecated name for shipping_promotion_rebate: the order shipping promotion (Promotion/Shipping, ShippingDiscount). Despite the name it is a customer rebate, not an Amazon fee. Use shipping_promotion_rebate. The Amazon promotion fee is in promotion_shipping.

columns.name: shipping_promotion_rebate
columns.description: Order shipping promotion (Promotion/Shipping, ShippingDiscount) given to the customer, for example free shipping. Negative. Not an Amazon fee. Same values as promotion_fee. Refunds of it are in refund_shipping_promotion.

columns.name: cost_of_advertising
columns.description: Settlement amount Amazon deducted for advertising (ServiceFee, Cost of Advertising). It is 0 when advertising is invoiced separately and not taken from the settlement. Profit uses ad_spend from ads reports, so 0 here is not missing advertising cost. Expenses are negative.

columns.name: refund_item_withheld_tax
columns.description: ItemWithheldTax on a refund, including US MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-*. EU/UK MarketplaceFacilitatorVAT-* refunds are in refund_marketplace_facilitator_vat.

columns.name: refund_marketplace_facilitator_vat
columns.description: EU/UK MarketplaceFacilitatorVAT-* ItemWithheldTax refunded by Amazon. US MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-* stays in refund_item_withheld_tax.

columns.name: refund_shipping_promotion
columns.description: Refund of the order shipping promotion (shipping_promotion_rebate). Positive when the discount is given back on a refund.

columns.name: refund_digital_services_fee
columns.description: Digital Services Fee reversed on a refund (Refund + Digital Services Fee / DigitalServicesFee + ItemFees).

columns.name: points_returned
columns.description: Japan marketplace Amazon Points returned on a refund. Other marketplaces are 0.

columns.name: points_fee
columns.description: Japan marketplace Amazon Points fee on a refund. Other marketplaces are 0.

columns.name: shipping_label_purchase
columns.description: Merchant-fulfilled Buy Shipping / Amazon label purchase, including postage surcharges and VAT on that purchase.
